d: ACS Group is looking for an experienced and highly organized Executive Assistant to join our Travel & Lifestyle team.

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys supporting executives, managing complex international schedules, and delivering outstanding service at the highest standards.

In this role, you will provide executive-level support with a strong focus on travel, coordinating international arrangements across multiple destinations and working with leading hotels, airlines, private aviation providers, VIP airport services, and premium partners worldwide.
If you thrive in a fast-paced international environment, have exceptional attention to detail, and know how to turn requests into seamless experiences, we would love to hear from you.
q: 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Travel Coordinator, or in a similar role supporting senior executives or high-net-worth individuals.
Solid experience organizing international travel; exposure to private aviation, VIP airport services, or GDS platforms is a strong advantage.
Willingness to travel internationally and accompany executives when required.
Excellent organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to anticipate needs before they arise.
A proactive, service-oriented mindset and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
High standards of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
r: Provide day-to-day support to executives and their guests, with a primary focus on international business and leisure travel.
Arrange hotel accommodations, commercial flights, private jet charters, transfers, and exclusive activities.
Research destinations, identify exceptional experiences, and prepare tailored proposals.
Source and negotiate competitive rates with hotels, airlines, travel agencies, and other service providers.
Monitor all bookings, ensuring accuracy, quality, and seamless execution.
Prepare itineraries, destination guides, and weekly event recommendations.
Coordinate private aviation requests and compare charter options.
Arrange VIP airport assistance, Fast Track services, and meet-and-greet arrangements.
Verify flight details, passenger information, tickets, and travel documentation.
Coordinate changes to arrangements and ensure smooth transitions between destinations.
Maintain an organized travel and activity calendar and coordinate schedules with relevant departments.
Organize ground transportation, private drivers, and car rentals.
Coordinate accommodation and travel for accompanying staff and guests.
Manage travel insurance and ensure all necessary arrangements are in place.
Monitor schedules and proactively identify potential conflicts or logistical challenges.
Maintain accurate records, documentation, and correspondence.
Review invoices, supplier statements, payment statuses, and booking conditions.
Monitor cancellation policies, payment deadlines, and reservation hold periods.
Prepare daily task updates, prioritize requests, and maintain clear handovers between shifts.
Provide support through dedicated communication channels during assigned shifts.
Monitor incoming requests and respond promptly to changing priorities.
Work closely with the Travel & Lifestyle team and other departments.
Ensure smooth communication and continuity of service between shifts.
x: International Work Environment: Work with global destinations, premium hospitality partners, and international service providers.
Remote Flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere.
Structured Work Schedule: Rotational schedule of 2 working days followed by 2 days off, in coordination with another team member.
Professional Exposure: Gain experience supporting executives and managing complex international arrangements with leading luxury travel providers.
Travel Opportunities: Possibility of international business trips alongside executives.
Compensation: Competitive remuneration based on experience and qualifications.

If you are passionate about travel, understand the importance of exceptional service, and can manage multiple international arrangements with precision and confidence, we would be delighted to hear from you.

d: Abdulaziz Alsuhayman Law Firm is a specialized corporate law firm providing comprehensive legal services for businesses. We collaborate with local and regional clients on complex corporate transactions, commercial contracts, advisory services, commercial disputes, and arbitration. We are seeking a driven Lawyer with a strong command of legal drafting and a commitment to building a successful legal career.

We offer a challenging environment with direct exposure to high-impact local and regional deals. You will benefit from continuous professional development, mentorship from senior partners, and a clear career trajectory for growth within the firm.
q: Licensed to practice law in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Mandatory).
Bachelor’s degree in Law or Sharia; an LL.M is preferred.
Minimum of 3 years of practical experience in reputable law firms.
Excellent command of legal drafting and communication in Arabic (Essential).
Strong proficiency in English (both drafting and communication) is considered a strong advantage and highly preferred.
Strong knowledge of Saudi law, Sharia principles, and commercial/business laws, with experience in local and cross-border matters.
Practical understanding of corporate law, compliance, commercial contracts, and litigation/arbitration procedures.
Familiarity with legal tech tools for document and task management.
Superior communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
Proven ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities efficiently.
r: The Lawyer will be a key contributor to the firm’s daily legal activities, leading workstreams under supervision. The role requires ensuring accurate and timely delivery of tasks and providing comprehensive, innovative solutions for complex matters, particularly in:

Drafting & Transactions: Drafting, reviewing, and preparing various legal documents, commercial contracts, partnership agreements, NDAs, and service agreements; preparing precise, practical legal recommendations for complex transactions.
Analyzing, summarizing, and proposing amendments to complex legal documents, maintaining strong attention to detail.
Contributing actively to legal due diligence processes and supporting Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) transactions.
Preparing legal memoranda, pleadings, and briefs for commercial litigation and Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) proceedings.

Practice Management: Managing legal files against clear timelines, tracking billable hours and progress, and utilizing document-management and time-tracking tools efficiently to ensure organized workflow.
Conducting in-depth legal research on applicable Saudi laws, regulations, and judicial precedents.
Writing legal articles and newsletters to support firm knowledge and client communication.

d: Vodafone is Oman’s latest Network Operator. The presence of Vodafone in Oman will contribute to the development of all sectors, including the economic and educational sectors, and in line with Oman Vision 2040.

Our purpose is to ‘Connect for a Better Future ‘which underpins everything we do. Our solutions will positively impact society as we connect everyone in Oman for a better future. What we offer are market-leading customer experiences and innovative digital services.

We are looking for energetic self-starters to work in this 100% Omani owned, positive collaborative start-up environment, where key talents will create Oman’s happiest workplace. We are looking for individuals with an entrepreneurial mindset who get excited by challenges and constant change and truly want to positively impact the lives of our customers and the people of Oman.

As part of our Budget and Vendor Management team, we are looking for a Technology Financial Analyst to provide financial planning, analysis, control and reporting across the Technology function. The role will manage Capex and Opex tracking, budgeting, forecasting, purchase orders, invoices, accruals and vendor expenditure, enabling accurate financial decisions, strong governance and effective cost optimisation.
The role will work closely with Network, IT and Operations teams to ensure alignment between financial planning, technology requirements and operational priorities.
q: Strong financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting capability.
Sound understanding of Capex, Opex, accruals, commitments, purchase orders and invoice lifecycle management.
High attention to detail, sound judgement and a control-focused mindset.
Ability to translate complex financial data into concise, actionable management insights.
Advanced stakeholder management and ability to work across Technology, Finance, Supply Chain and vendors.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet reporting deadlines.
Commercial awareness and a proactive cost-optimisation mindset.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, management accounting or Technology finance.
Experience in telecommunications, IT, digital services or project-based environments is preferred.
Accuracy and timeliness of monthly Technology financial reporting and accrual submissions.
Forecast accuracy and quality of budget variance explanations.
Percentage of Technology expenditure maintained within approved budgets.
Timely reconciliation of open purchase orders, invoices, accruals and financial commitments.
Reduction in ageing commitments, delayed invoices and unutilised budget.
Value of cost savings, avoidance and optimisation opportunities identified.
Compliance with financial controls, procurement requirements and audit actions.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modelling, PivotTables, lookups and reconciliations.
Experience with ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle or equivalent.
Power BI or similar business intelligence experience is preferred.
ACCA, CIMA, CMA, CPA, CFA or a similar professional certification is an advantage.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
r: Coordinate annual Technology Capex and Opex budgeting, periodic forecasting and budget reallocation with budget owners.
Prepare monthly and quarterly financial dashboards covering budget, actual spend, commitments, accruals and forecast.
•Analyse variances, spending trends, funding gaps and financial risks, and provide clear recommendations to Technology leadership.
Maintain consolidated trackers for purchase requests, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices, payments and remaining commitments.
Monthly Technology accrual process and reconcile accruals against purchase orders, invoices and financial postings.
Monitor project, contract and vendor expenditure against approved budgets, commercial terms and delivery milestones.
Review cost proposals, renewals and business cases, supporting financial evaluation, benchmarking and cost optimisation.
Coordinate with Finance, Supply Chain, Accounts Payable, project teams and vendors to resolve financial discrepancies and payment issues.
Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing, including ageing commitments, capitalisation and carry-forward requirements.
Ensure compliance with financial policies, procurement processes, delegated authority and audit requirements.
Maintain reliable financial records and audit trails, and respond to management, audit and governance information requests.
Continuously improve Technology financial controls, reporting tools, data quality and stakeholder awareness.
